# MeasureWise

> Quality operations platform for Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs). Plan PDSA cycles, track UDS measures on SPC charts, and export the HRSA Audit Binder.

MeasureWise links quality improvement work to UDS scores and HRSA OSV readiness. Built by Jessica R. Smith, BSN — an FQHC Quality Director.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and value proposition for FQHC quality teams.
- [How It Works](/#how-it-works): Walkthrough of PDSA cycles, SPC charts, and evidence exports.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Solo $149, Multi-Site $349, Network $699 — 14-day free trial on every plan.
- [About](/about): Founder story and mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the MeasureWise team.
- [Status](/status): System uptime and incident history.
- [Security & Compliance](/security): TLS 1.2+, AES-256, aggregate UDS data only, no PHI stored.
- [AthenaOne Operations Manual](/manual): $197 one-time PDF — FQHC AthenaOne workflows, CPT codes, macros, SOPs.

## Features

- [Features](/features): One page covering PDSA cycles, UDS tracking, SPC charts, HRSA Audit Binder export, and QI/QA board reports.
